nodes.name: Visitor Identified Webhook
nodes.notes:
Compatible with any de-anonymization tool that fires a webhook on visitor identification:
  • Salesbox AI: Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Trigger: 'Visitor Identified'
  • Clearbit Reveal: Webhooks → Event: 'company.identified'
  • Albacross: API Integrations → Webhook
  • Leadfeeder: Webhooks (via Zapier or native)
  • RB2B: Webhook → 'Person Identified'

Paste this webhook URL into whichever tool you use. No page-level filtering needed here — customise the 'Page Filter' node below.

nodes.name: Page Filter (Customise Me)
nodes.notes:
────────────────────────────────────────
CUSTOMISE THIS NODE for your use case:

• Add / remove conditions freely.
  Each condition checks pageUrl contains a keyword.
• The combinator is OR — any match proceeds.
• Common patterns to use:
    'pricing'  → /pricing, /pricing-plans
    'demo'     → /book-demo, /request-demo
    'plans'    → /plans, /compare-plans
    'contact'  → /contact-sales
    'checkout' → /checkout
    'upgrade'  → /upgrade

• To process ALL visitors regardless of page,
  delete all conditions and set combinator to OR
  (empty OR = always true). Or bypass this node
  entirely by connecting Parse directly to Apollo.
────────────────────────────────────────

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ignored', reason: 'Page not in filter list', page: $json.pageUrl }) }}

nodes.name: Apollo: Enrich Contact
nodes.notes:
Credential setup: HTTP Header Auth
  Header Name  → x-api-key
  Header Value → your Apollo.io API key
  (Apollo v1 accepts key via x-api-key header or body api_key field)

Endpoint: POST https://api.apollo.io/v1/people/match
Docs: https://apolloio.github.io/apollo-api-docs/?shell#people-enrichment

nodes.name: SalesRobot: Add to Voice Note Campaign
nodes.notes:
Credential: HTTP Header Auth
  Header Name  → X-API-KEY
  Header Value → key from app.salesrobot.co → Settings → API Key

Endpoint: POST https://api.boomtechinc.com/api/add-from-csv
  (api.boomtechinc.com is SalesRobot's API domain)
Query params (set as n8n Variables):
  SALESROBOT_LINKEDIN_ACCOUNT_UUID  — LinkedIn account UUID from SalesRobot
  SALESROBOT_VOICE_NOTE_CAMPAIGN_UUID — pre-created voice-note campaign UUID

The campaign must already exist in SalesRobot with a voice note step.
Docs: https://help.salesrobot.co/api

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Contact
nodes.notes:
Searches by email OR LinkedIn URL (filterGroups = OR between groups).
Endpoint: POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/search
Docs: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/search

nodes.name: HubSpot: Create Contact
nodes.notes:
Creates a new contact.
Endpoint: POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts
Note: visitor_identified_at, identified_page_url, linkedin_voice_note_sent,
voice_note_sent_at are custom properties — create them in HubSpot under
Contacts → Properties before activating this workflow.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Update Existing Contact
HubSpot: Log Activity Note
nodes.notes:
Creates a note associated with the contact (associationTypeId 202 = note→contact).
Endpoint: POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/notes
Docs: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/notes

nodes.name: Slack: Notify AE
nodes.notes:
Set these in n8n Variables:
  SLACK_AE_CHANNEL_ID  — Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123456789)
  HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID    — your HubSpot portal/account ID

nodes.name: HubSpot: Check Meeting Booked
nodes.notes:
Endpoint: GET https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/{id}
Returns current values of meetings_booked and num_associated_deals.

nodes.name: Stop (Meeting / Deal Exists)
nodes.notes: Meeting booked or deal already exists — skip follow-up to avoid over-messaging.

nodes.name: SalesRobot: Send 24hr Follow-up
nodes.notes:
Same endpoint, different campaign UUID.
Set SALESROBOT_FOLLOWUP_CAMPAIGN_UUID in n8n Variables.
This campaign should contain a text message (not voice note).
